# laravelforge_security_rule (Resource)

Manages a security rule (HTTP basic-auth protection) on a Laravel Forge site. Credentials (username/password) are an object array not managed in this pass.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Security rule name.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site to attach the rule to.

### Optional

- `path` (String) Protected path (null/omitted protects all routes).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the security rule.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
